title: Track 8 M0 sanitized raw JSON-RPC evidence

sanitization.note: Only public contract/account addresses already present in the integrated evidence or owner-authorized M0 record are retained.

provenance_limits.original_m0_raw_envelopes: The original M0 session retained decoded values and exact pins but did not persist raw JSON-RPC envelopes. This artifact does not reconstruct them. It replays the same immutable blocks through named credential-free endpoints.
provenance_limits.base_provider_change: BASE-M0-01 and BASE-M0-02 originally used https://base-rpc.publicnode.com. Historical replay now requires a token there, so the raw amendment replay uses https://base-mainnet.public.blastapi.io. The original endpoint fact remains recorded and is not relabeled.
provenance_limits.track_2_historical_fork: RH-T2-01 requests and responses are not included because they were prior integrated evidence, not a fresh M0 raw capture. No historical response is fabricated.
